description: Looks for the proof of each of the host's addresses from get_ports: the file served at the address, or its reverse DNS (PTR) under the host resolving back to it with the TXT record in place. The TXT record alone proves no address. The proof must stay in place, since every scan checks it again; only covered addresses are scanned. Free.
name: verify_host
title: Verify a monitor's host for port scans
